data.title: Inventory requests are timing out intermittently
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: Alert correlation tentatively points to checkout-service.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The intermittent timeouts in inventory requests are caused by a transient network partition or high latency between checkout-service and inventory-service, leading to failed calls that cascade into checkout failures.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify network connectivity and latency between checkout-service and inventory-service in the affected region.', success_signal='Ping/Traceroute shows <50ms latency and no packet loss; no routing anomalies detected.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Check inventory-service health and resource utilization (CPU, memory, thread pool saturation).', success_signal='Health endpoint returns 200 OK; CPU <70%, memory <80%, thread pool not saturated.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Inspect request logs for failed inventory calls (HTTP 5xx, timeouts) and correlate timestamps with checkout failures.', success_signal='Logs show >30% of inventory calls timing out during the incident window, aligning with checkout errors.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Validate load balancer/traffic routing configuration for inventory-service; ensure no misconfigured health checks or circuit breakers.', success_signal='Health checks pass; circuit breaker thresholds not exceeded.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Apply a temporary retry policy with exponential backoff to inventory calls in checkout-service.', success_signal='Retry count increases; checkout success rate improves to >99% within 5 minutes.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='If retries resolve the issue, investigate underlying cause (e.g., transient network glitch) and implement network stability measures (e.g., additional health checks, redundant paths).', success_signal='Network stability metrics return to baseline; no further timeouts observed.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='If retries do not resolve, perform a rolling restart of inventory-service instances to clear any stale state.', success_signal='Post-restart, inventory call success rate returns to 100% and checkout success rate stabilizes.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Document findings, update runbooks, and schedule a post-mortem to prevent recurrence.', success_signal='Runbook updated; post-mortem scheduled within 24 hours.', status='pending')], revision=1, rationale_summary='The alert correlation points to checkout-service, yet the ticket lists order-service as suspected. Inventory requests are the root of the timeout, suggesting the issue lies in the communication path or the inventory-service itself. A network partition or latency spike would cause intermittent failures without affecting other services, matching the observed intermittent timeouts and the impact on checkout completion rate.')
